name: palmdown
_note: a palm laid DOWN on a worktop or the floor, seen side-on: the back of the hand a low dome, the fingers a little apart and curling enough that the tips rest on the surface (the hand drawn sloping ~10° down from the wrist to them), the thumb under the hand out of sight. With fx.fingersIn 0.7 and the hand's width squashed edge-on (pose.scale hand: [1, 0.6]). 'press' (fingers straight, thumb up) on the worktop read as 'the wrong way around', its fingers out in the air (Harry, round 8)
